en.hubeali:
Sahl Bin Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Ibn Abu Najran, or someone else, from Hanaan, from his father, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The Kabah complained to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic what is faced from the (smelly) breating from the Polytheists. So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Revealed unto it: “Calm down, Kabah, for I<sup>azwj</sup> would be Replacing them with a people who would be cleaning (their teeth) with the twigs of the tree”. 
So when Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Sent Muhammad<sup>azwj</sup>, Revealed unto him<sup>saww</sup> with Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> with the brushing of the teeth, and picking the teeth (with a tooth-pick)’.
en.sarwar: 32. Sahl ibn Ziyad has narrated from Mansur ibn al-‘Abbas from ibn abu Najran or others from Hanan from his father who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

Al-Ka‘bah complained before Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, against the bad breath of the pagans. Allah sent a revelation that said, ‘Calm down. I will replace them with a people who will use twigs for cleaning up their mouths. 5 Allah then raised Muhammad, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, and Jibril brought him revelation that instructed him to brush and clean up his mouth.’”
